User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the EvoluaEla application.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user, provided by Firebase Auth.

photoURL.description: The URL to the user's profile photo.

isPremium.description: Indicates whether the user has an active premium subscription.

subscriptionStatus.description: The current status of the user's subscription.

trialEndDate.description: The end date of the user's free trial, if applicable.

createdAt.description: The date and time the user account was created.

lastLoginAt.description: The date and time the user last logged in.

coachMessagesCount.description: The number of messages the user has sent to the AI coach.

EmotionalStats.title: EmotionalStats
EmotionalStats.description: Tracks the user's emotional progress across different areas.

userId.description: The ID of the user these stats belong to.

updatedAt.description: The date and time the stats were last updated.

DailyMission.title: DailyMission
DailyMission.description: A daily task or habit for the user to complete.

id.description: The unique identifier for the mission.

userId.description: The ID of the user this mission belongs to.

title.description: The title or description of the mission.

completed.description: Indicates whether the mission has been completed.

date.description: The date this mission is assigned for (YYYY-MM-DD).

createdAt.description: The date and time the mission was created.

JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: An entry in the user's emotional journal.

id.description: The unique identifier for the journal entry.

userId.description: The ID of the user who created the entry.

date.description: The date and time the entry was created.

content.description: The text content of the journal entry.

aiResponse.description: The AI's response to the journal entry, if any.

promptUsed.description: The prompt that inspired the entry, if any.

OnboardingAnswers.title: OnboardingAnswers
OnboardingAnswers.description: The user's answers to the onboarding questionnaire.

userId.description: The ID of the user these answers belong to.

feeling.description: How the user currently feels about their body.

updatedAt.description: The date and time the answers were last updated.

Workout.title: Workout
Workout.description: A custom workout created or saved by the user.

id.description: The unique identifier for the workout.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns the workout.

duration.description: The estimated duration of the workout.

level.description: The difficulty level of the workout.

premium.description: Indicates if the workout is a premium template.

items.description: A JSON stringified representation of the Exercise object.

exercises.description: The list of exercises in the workout. Serialized as JSON strings due to Firestore nested array limitations.

createdAt.description: The date and time the workout was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time the workout was last updated.

users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles and account settings.

users/{userId}/emotionalStats/current.description: Stores the user's current emotional statistics.

users/{userId}/journalEntries/{entryId}.description: Stores the user's emotional journal entries.

users/{userId}/onboarding/answers.description: Stores the user's onboarding questionnaire answers.
